subject: Authorization required: Senior Inference IC — salary exception & approval path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: salary authorization (Priya Desai, Sr. Inference Engineer)

Hi Karthik,

Candidate: Priya Desai (onsite loop completed last week). Panel feedback: strong runtime/serving depth, leadership in compiler optimizations, excellent system design. Hiring committee recommends IC4 (Senior) but compensation band needs an exception to land.

Proposed comp: 175k base / 20% target equity / 15% bonus. This sits above the published band for the role by ~10% for base. I attached the market comp snapshot and our recommended rationale.

As hiring manager, can you sign off to route for finance/people approval? We need an authorization note for the offer packet by end of week to meet candidate timeline.

Attachments: Comp_Range_Priya_Desai.pdf, RemComp_benchmark_snapshot.csv

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: salary authorization (Priya Desai, Sr. Inference Engineer)

Thanks Marissa — I reviewed the packet. Quick questions before I escalate:
- Why IC4 vs IC3 (benchmarks seem mid/high IC3 range)? Was leveling driven by scope or candidate ask?
- Can you attach the comp history for this req and offers we made in last 6 months for similar profile?

Assuming the committee justification is clear, Im ok routing for a one-time exception. If Lauren or Vivek wants to weigh in on total comp ceiling please chime.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Director, Inference Platform
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: salary authorization (Priya Desai, Sr. Inference Engineer)

Karthik — answers inline:
- Leveling: panel recommended IC4 because Priya led inference compilation at previous company, owned cross-team rollouts, and scoped feature delivery for 3 major releases. Shes above a typical IC3 profile on impact and breadth.
- Comp history: attached the 3 most comparable offers (Q1–Q2 2026) and the RemComp market snapshot.

Candidate asks for a decision this week; she has other active conversations. If we cannot meet the proposed package we risk losing her.

Requested action: manager sign-off to route to Finance + People Ops for exception approval and DocuSign routing.

Marissa

Attachments: Comp_Range_Priya_Desai.pdf, RemComp_benchmark_snapshot.csv
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: salary authorization (Priya Desai, Sr. Inference Engineer)

Karthik/Marissa — I read the packet. Im generally comfortable with leveling rationale. Two asks before I greenlight routing:
1) Please confirm total cash (base + expected bonus) and on-target comp with currency breakouts (we pay semi-annual RSU vesting cadence note).
2) Ben, will Finance sign off on the exception given current hiring budget for the Inference org? If not, what constraints do we need to surface?

If both check out, I authorize routing to Ben for final finance sign-off and then we can issue the offer.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop | Head of People Operations
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: salary authorization (Priya Desai, Sr. Inference Engineer)

Team — reviewed forecast and current headcount spend for Q3. We can approve a 10% over-band base as a one-off for mission-critical hires, provided:
- Total cash (base + target bonus) does not exceed $205,000
- Req is filed as an exception with a brief justification memo attached to the offer packet (People will archive)

I'll authorize routing once I see the final numbers and the memo. Marissa, please prepare DocuSign link and the exception memo (2–3 bullets).

Ben Carter | VP, Finance Operations
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Final — approved routing and DocuSign link (Priya Desai)

Team — per Ben's conditions we adjusted the package: 170,000 base / 15% bonus target = total cash ~195,500 (below the $205k ceiling). Equity unchanged at 20% target grant. Exception memo attached and DocuSign envelope created.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/REDWOOD/ENVELOPE/abc123 (envelope prepared; signers: People Ops -> Finance -> Hiring Manager)
Exception memo (2 bullets):
- Candidate brings cross-cutting inference runtime experience and delivered 30% latency improvements at scale at previous employer.
- Market scarcity for senior compiler/runtime ICs; multiple competing offers.

Please confirm and I will issue the formal offer to Priya.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachments: DocuSign_offer-routing-link.txt, Comp_Range_Priya_Desai.pdf
